decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY establishing white text, the required font, and no caption effects; the source Requirement's clarified ban on general visual effects adds no missing candidate-state change.
The ban on animations and other visual effects does not change the independently defined completeness or teaching-value criteria, which already have their own same-message MODIFY.
The editing-effects restriction does not alter permitted source content or the requirement that all three trial clips come from one YouTube video.
Removing visual effects does not change the requirement to select strong source moments; the message's teaching-moment clause is represented by the separate completeness Requirement.
The clarified visual-effects rule does not change the 30-to-90-second duration bounds.

The clips' failure to satisfy editing standards is execution evidence already recorded for qualification, but the visual-effects modification does not change the qualification method, clip count, deadline, or success condition.
The trial-clip editing restriction does not change the deferred Lead Clipper pathway, compensation, training focus, or role status.
The visual-effects standard does not alter the requirement for 125 approved clips per month.
The editing-style modification does not change the project-chat submission channel or the content submitted for guideline review.
